title: Master chain
description: The end of the song: takes the final mix, applies a limiter and a loudness target, and gives the audio that is rendered. A slice can cut one part of the arrangement out (slice_from and slice_to, in bars; set it by dragging on the ruler of the Arrangement).

parameters.name: limiter
parameters.doc: Limiter ceiling in decibels below full scale.

parameters.name: target
parameters.doc: Loudness target: -14 for streaming, -16 for podcasts, -23 for EBU broadcast; type another if you need it.

parameters.name: slice_from
parameters.doc: The first bar of the part of the song that comes out of the master (empty: from the start). Together with slice_to this cuts that part out of the arrangement: the sound of the master starts at the beginning of the part.

parameters.name: slice_to
parameters.doc: The last bar of the part that comes out of the master, that bar included (empty: to the end of the song).

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: The default of the song for blocks that say auto: auto leaves every block as it is (stereo when its input or source is stereo), mono or stereo forces that for all blocks without their own channels value.
